name: Verog the Dervish
summary: Across the southern Barrens, Verog the Dervish keeps moving, and Regthar Deathgate seeks to draw him out. The orc directs Horde champions to attack the Kolkar command tent at the Stagnant Oasis, hoping to force the nomadic leader into the open.

sections.title: Drawing Out the Dervish
sections.body: After Barak Kodobane fell, Regthar Deathgate turned to the remaining Kolkar warlords. Barak had stayed near the northern waters of the Forgotten Pools, but Verog the Dervish roams the sun-baked plains and rarely lingers in one camp. Horde scouts cannot easily track him across that wide territory. Their chance is to make the commander come to them.

sections.title: The Stagnant Oasis
sections.body: Verog operates from the Kolkar command post at the Stagnant Oasis, southeast of the Crossroads. Regthar sends you against the camp, where you strike the Kolkar warriors near their command tent. Their alarm calls Verog back to defend the outpost, bringing him within reach of the Horde blades.

faq.answer: Verog the Dervish leads the Kolkar centaur in the Barrens. He commands from the Stagnant Oasis but roams the southern wastes, making him hard to corner.

faq.q: Why doesn't Verog stay in his camp?
faq.answer: Verog wanders the Barrens rather than remaining in one camp. His movements make it hard for Horde war parties to find him, so his enemies must provoke him to return.
Threaten Verog's tribe at the Stagnant Oasis command post. Attacking the Kolkar near their command tent raises an alarm that brings him back to defend it.
Regthar Deathgate orders Verog's death. The orc veteran camps west of the Crossroads, along the main road to the Stonetalon Mountains, and hunts the Kolkar's regional commanders one by one.

After Verog falls, you bring his severed head to Regthar, who adds it beside Barak Kodobane's. Regthar then turns his attention to Hezrul Bloodmark, the centaur warlord at the Lushwater Oasis to the south.

faq.q: Why are the Kolkar centaur such a problem in the Barrens?
faq.answer: The Kolkar threaten the Barrens by claiming its vital water sources and raiding caravans, outposts, and native tauren herds. Their attacks endanger the Horde's fledgling presence in central Kalimdor.

angles.text: As an orc, you know Regthar Deathgate sees the Kolkar warlords' defeat as essential to securing the road between the Crossroads and the Stonetalon Mountains for Durotar's travelers.
As a tauren, you know the Kolkar hunted and harassed your nomadic people across these plains for generations. Verog's execution brings long-awaited retribution.
As a member of the Horde, you know the oases are vital to survival in the arid Barrens. Defeating centaur commanders helps keep water routes open to supply caravans.
